author: Grand Canyon Times
title: Governor Hobbs vetoes Arizona House's budget proposals
text:
Steve Montenegro, Arizona State Representative for 29th District | Wikipedia
Steve Montenegro, Arizona State Representative for 29th District | Wikipedia
Arizona Governor Katie Hobbs has vetoed two budget proposals from the Arizona House of Representatives. The first was a balanced budget approved earlier this month, and the second was a continuation budget passed to prevent a government shutdown after June 30.
Speaker of the House Steve Montenegro expressed his disappointment in response to the vetoes. "I’m disappointed the Governor has now vetoed two responsible budgets passed by the House—each of which would have prevented a government shutdown and kept essential state services running," he said. He emphasized that the House had fulfilled its responsibilities by passing budgets focused on core needs and responsible spending.
Montenegro noted that after the initial plan was rejected, a continuation budget was proposed to avoid disruption and allow for further negotiations. Both proposals were ultimately rejected by Governor Hobbs.
Despite these setbacks, Montenegro assured that House Republicans would continue efforts to maintain government operations and protect taxpayers from political challenges. The budgets aimed at ensuring public safety, infrastructure, and oversight while exercising fiscal restraint.
Steve Montenegro represents Legislative District 29 in areas including Goodyear and Surprise.
